author: sonnet
label: climb-02-01
changes: Decision 2 and 4: a missing or malformed sid is treated as no session, with no query, then clear cookie and redirect (Q1).
Decision 5: the lockout write also deletes that email's failure rows, so the count restarts when the lock ends. Diagram updated (Q2).
Decision 3 and diagram: stated that users is existing and unchanged and what the lookup selects. Also stated that a new session starts both clocks at now() (Q3, Q6).
Decision 5 and diagram: defined the 429 body and the Retry-After computation (Q4).
Notes and diagram: GET /login ignores the session, logout without a cookie skips the delete, and /dashboard is named as the protected landing page (Q5, Q6).
Decision 6: a failed cleanup run is logged and caught up by the next run, with no alerting.
Added an Open questions section for cleanup alerting and for /dashboard being out of scope (Q6, Q7).
Diagram: protected page now branches on no usable cookie, and logout wraps the delete in opt for no cookie.
Merged the brute-force rules in decision 5 into the order they run: lock, then bcrypt, then record failure, then lock on 5, then success clears.
Moved the advisory-lock cross-instance remark from the Two instances note into decision 5 and shortened that note.
Cut the repeated 'users table unchanged / login looks up by email' sentence and the 'new session starts with created_at and last_seen_at at now()' line (covered by schema defaults).
Merged 'No user data goes in the cookie' into the cookie bullet and removed the duplicate cookie-clearing mentions.
Shortened the cleanup failure text and the Redis fallback text.
Merged the storage-failure table rows' side remark about not revealing credentials into the login row; collapsed login failure cases into 'any read or write'.
Removed the /dashboard restatement from the route guard note (kept in Open questions) and the 'Identical failure responses' duplication of rules already in decision 5.
Open questions kept together at the end of the prose, before the diagram.
